mapper.insert: insert into batch_alert_event ( agent_id, task_id, alert_level, alert_category, alert_title, alert_message, metrics_snapshot, is_resolved, notification_sent, notification_channels, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{agentId}, #{taskId}, #{alertLevel}, #{alertCategory}, #{alertTitle}, #{alertMessage}, #{metricsSnapshot}, #{isResolved}, #{notificationSent}, #{notificationChannels}, #{createBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: select id, agent_id, task_id, alert_level, alert_category, alert_title, alert_message, is_resolved, create_time from batch_alert_event where is_resolved = 0 order by create_time desc

select id, agent_id, task_id, alert_level, alert_category, alert_title, alert_message, is_resolved, resolved_by, resolved_at, resolution_note, create_time from batch_alert_event order by create_time desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update batch_alert_event set is_resolved = 1, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{id}
